title: Plasma ammunition back aboard: withdraw the stored dispersal plasma cell packs at Nova Terra Central into the Plasma Cannon II ship's hold
note: 2026-11-22 08:08 UTC (Apophis): the Plasma Cannon II ship's hold was empty while 3 dispersal plasma cell packs lay in its storage at Nova Terra Central (tool stock, 08:06 UTC); its last test run (07:18 UTC) killed nothing, with the hull at 100 percent: the magazine was empty. A hunt stores its hold at its station; hunt.py keeps only the loaded ammo id out of the store (AMMO = ammo_ids(), read once at the start), so packs can land in storage when no ammo id is loaded (a guess, not measured). This circuit puts them back aboard; it opens only for a pilot with the cannon and packs in its own storage there (requires.stored). Fitting for the ship's own weapon, shared work (rule F23): nothing is sold or bought.
